explanation: The fdopendir function is used to convert an open file descriptor into a DIR structure, allowing it to be used with directory handling functions like readdir or closedir. It is particularly useful when you already have a file descriptor from opening a directory, as it provides a way to integrate low-level file operations with higher-level directory streaming, making directory reading more flexible in POSIX-compliant systems.
